Capital Works Program 2026/27

The City will invest in these projects during the year.

Roads and intersections

Ardross Street and Munro Road Roundabout Installation ($700,000) External funding secured under the Black Spot funding program

Norma Road and McCoy Street Roundabout ($550,000) Roundabout construction with Black Spot funding from the Federal Government.

Leach Highway Path Renewal ($1.2 million)

Shared path renewal between Canning Highway and the river, funded from the municipal reserve.

Buildings and car parks

  • Morris Buzzacott Reserve car park renewal ($700,000) Car park resurfacing and drainage at Bicton.
  • Applecross Library roof replacement ($250,000) Roof replacement. Amount is excluding GST.

Community consultation is open until 30 June.
